Water supply hours

The water is turned on at the start of April and off again at the end of October, so that the pipes do not freeze. In those months the supply runs from six in the morning until nine at night. Fill your cans and barrels from the troughs, and do not leave a hose running on a plot when you are not there.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
